title: Optimizing global genomic surveillance for early detection of emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants
description: Modeling study evaluating how targeted genomic surveillance at international travel hubs can improve early detection of emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants and reduce delays compared with broader sampling approaches.
keyFeatures: Models targeted surveillance strategies for emerging SARS-CoV-2 variant detection.
Compares travel-hub sampling with broader surveillance allocation approaches.
Uses resource allocation and detection-delay metrics relevant to early warning systems.
Supports planning discussions on where limited sequencing capacity may have greatest impact.
practicalUse: Use this study to inform strategic allocation of sequencing and sampling resources for early variant detection, especially when surveillance capacity is limited.
